title: Reopen shows the green message that the work order reopened
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location has no accounting integration (neither QuickBooks Online nor AccountingHub).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Open the invoice menu on the Finance tab.
  4. Click "Reopen Work Order".
  5. Click Reopen Work Order in the window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens, Closed.

Step 2:

  • The document shows.

Step 3:

  • The menu offers "Reopen Work Order".

Step 4:

  • The window opens.

Step 5:

  • A green message reads "Work order [number] reopened" with work order 1's number.
  • The status reads "Complete".

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.3 (12 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11761 (Story 4, Reopen a closed internal or no-charge work order)

  • S4-R3: “Confirming reverses exactly the entries that were posted at Close (Stories 7 and 8), returns the parts to inventory as Reverse does today, removes the internal invoice, and sets the work order to Complete with its classification unchanged, the shop supplies amount kept, and the Convert and Change category actions offered again (S2-R9 applies only while closed or invoiced); the green message "Work order [number] reopened" confirms it, as the app confirms other finished actions. The reversal is dated the reopen date, so it is held only if that date's period is closed or missing (S4-E2 is corrected accordingly). Events for one work order are processed in order, one at a time: a Reopen arriving while the Close is Held turns the Close Dismissed; a Dismissed event is never retried and cannot be replayed by hand; a new Close waits while an earlier reversal for the same work order is Held, shown as Held with the reason "Waiting for an earlier held entry of work order [n]", so two Close entries are never posted without the reversal between them. The reversal credits and debits exactly the accounts the Close used.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Reopen done | "Work order [number] reopened" | Green message (S4-R3)”
